passages.id_: Dari doa-doa Habib Umar bin Muhammad bin Salim bin Hafizh ibn asy-Syekh Abi Bakr bin Salim
passages.en: From the supplications of Habib Umar bin Muhammad bin Salim bin Hafiz ibn ash-Shaykh Abi Bakr bin Salim

passages.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُه، السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يا سيدَنا الحسين، السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يا سِبْطَ رسول اللَّه ﷺ، السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يا ريحانةَ سيدِنا رسول اللَّه ﷺ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuh. As-salâmu `alaykum yâ sayyidanal-Husayn. As-salâmu `alaykum yâ sibtha rasûlillâh. As-salâmu `alaykum yâ rayhânata sayyidinâ rasûlillâh.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya. Salam sejahtera atasmu, wahai junjungan kami al-Husain. Salam sejahtera atasmu, wahai cucu Rasulullah ﷺ. Salam sejahtera atasmu, wahai bunga kesayangan junjungan kami Rasulullah ﷺ.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings. Peace be upon you, O our master al-Husayn. Peace be upon you, O grandson of Allah's Messenger ﷺ. Peace be upon you, O sweet flower of our master, Allah's Messenger ﷺ.

passages.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُه يا سيدَ شبابِ أهلِ الجنَّةِ، السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُه يا أهلَ الدَّرَجَاتِ العُلى، السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُه يَا خِيَارَ الْمَلَأِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu yâ sayyida syabâbi ahlil-jannah. As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu yâ ahlad-darajâtil-`ulâ. As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu yâ khiyâral-mala'.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, wahai penghulu pemuda ahli surga. Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, wahai pemilik derajat-derajat tertinggi. Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, wahai insan-insan pilihan.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, O master of the youth of Paradise. Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, O people of the loftiest degrees. Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, O finest of the noble assembly.

passages.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُه يَا مَن قال عنكم صاحبُ المَقامِ المَحمودِ جَدُّكُم سَيِّدُنَا محمدُ بنُ عبدِ اللَّهِ ﷺ: «حُسَيْنٌ مِنِّي، وَأَنَا مِنْ حُسَيْنٍ، أَحَبَّ اللَّهُ مَنْ أَحَبَّ حُسَيْنًا».
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu yâ man qâla `ankum shâhibul-maqâmil-mahmûdi jaddukum sayyidunâ Muhammadu bnu `Abdillâhi shallallâhu `alayhi wa sallam: Husaynun minnî, wa ana min Husayn, ahabballâhu man ahabba Husaynâ.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, wahai engkau yang tentangnya pemilik al-Maqam al-Mahmud, kakekmu junjungan kami Muhammad bin Abdullah ﷺ, bersabda: "Husain dariku dan aku dari Husain; Allah mencintai siapa saja yang mencintai Husain."
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, O you of whom the possessor of the Praiseworthy Station, your grandfather our master Muhammad bin Abdullah ﷺ, said: "Husayn is of me and I am of Husayn; Allah loves whoever loves Husayn."

passages.ar: سلامًا يُدْخِلُنا اللَّه به في دائرَتِكُم، ويُثَبِّتُ لنا بِهِ حَقِيقَةَ مَحَبَّتِكُم، ويجعلُنا في خَوَاصِّ مَن يُحِبُّكُم، بِالصِّدقِ وَالإخْلَاصِ، فيُحِبُّه اللَّهُ، ورَسُولُه مُصطفَاهُ.
passages.tr: Salâman yudkhilunallâhu bihi fî dâ'iratikum, wa yutsabbitu lanâ bihi haqîqata mahabbatikum, wa yaj`alunâ fî khawâshshi man yuhibbukum, bish-shidqi wal-ikhlâsh, fayuhibbuhullâhu, wa rasûluhu mushthafâh.
passages.id_: Salam yang dengannya Allah memasukkan kami ke dalam lingkaran kalian, meneguhkan bagi kami hakikat kecintaan kepada kalian, dan menjadikan kami termasuk orang-orang istimewa yang mencintai kalian dengan jujur dan ikhlas — sehingga ia dicintai Allah dan Rasul pilihan-Nya.
passages.en: A greeting of peace by which Allah brings us into your circle, makes firm within us the reality of loving you, and places us among the elect of those who love you with truthfulness and sincerity — so that Allah loves him, as does His chosen Messenger.

passages.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُه وعلى أخيكَ الحسنِ، السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُه على أخيكَ سيّدنا مُحْسِنٍ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ akhîkal-Hasan. As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu `alâ akhîka sayyidinâ Muhsin.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas saudaramu al-Hasan. Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, atas saudaramu junjungan kami Muhsin.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, and upon your brother al-Hasan. Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, upon your brother our master Muhsin.

passages.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُه وعلى أخواتِك الكريماتِ سيِّدتِنا زينبَ وأُمِّ كُلْثُوم.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ akhawâtikal-karîmâti sayyidatinâ Zaynaba wa Ummi Kultsûm.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas saudari-saudarimu yang mulia, junjungan kami Zainab dan Ummu Kultsum.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, and upon your noble sisters, our lady Zaynab and Umm Kulthum.

passages.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُه وعلى أُمِّكُم سَيِّدَةِ نِساءِ العَالمِينَ فاطمةَ الزهراءِ، بَضْعَةِ سَيِّدِ المُرسلين.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ ummikum sayyidati nisâ'il-`âlamîna Fâthimataz-Zahrâ', badh`ati sayyidil-mursalîn.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas ibundamu, penghulu kaum wanita seluruh alam, Fathimah az-Zahra — belahan jiwa penghulu para rasul.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, and upon your mother, the leader of the women of all worlds, Fatimah az-Zahra — a very part of the Master of the Messengers.

passages.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُه وعلى أبيكم سيّدِنا علي بن أبي طالب، ذِي المَفاخرِ والمَناقب، ليثِ بني غالب.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ abîkum sayyidinâ `Aliyyi bni Abî Thâlib, dzil-mafâkhiri wal-manâqib, laytsi banî Ghâlib.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas ayahmu, junjungan kami Ali bin Abi Thalib — pemilik kebanggaan dan keutamaan, singa Bani Ghalib.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, and upon your father, our master Ali bin Abi Talib — the possessor of glories and virtues, the lion of the Banu Ghalib.

passages.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُه وعلى جدِّكم سيّدِ المرسلين ﷺ، السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُه وعلى جدِّكم حبيبِ ربِّ العالمِين ﷺ، السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُه وعلى جدِّكم سيّدِنا المُجْتَبى المُصطفَى الأمين ﷺ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ jaddikum sayyidil-mursalîn. As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ jaddikum habîbi rabbil-`âlamîn. As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ jaddikum sayyidinal-mujtabal-mushthafal-amîn.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas kakekmu penghulu para rasul ﷺ. Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas kakekmu kekasih Tuhan semesta alam ﷺ. Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas kakekmu junjungan kami yang terpilih, yang terpilih lagi terpercaya ﷺ.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, and upon your grandfather, the Master of the Messengers ﷺ. Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, and upon your grandfather, the Beloved of the Lord of the worlds ﷺ. Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, and upon your grandfather, our master — the elect, the chosen, the trustworthy ﷺ.

passages.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُه وعلى مَن بِهِ شَرَّفَكُم وَرَفَعَكُم اللَّه، جَدِّكُم المُصطفى المُجتبى ﷺ: مُحَمَّدِ بنِ عبدِ اللَّهِ بنِ عبدِ المُطَّلِبِ بنِ هَاشِم ابنِ عبدِ منافِ بنِ قُصَيِّ بنِ حَكيمِ بنِ مُرَّةَ بنِ كَعبِ بنِ لُؤَيِّ بنِ غَالِبِ بنِ فِهْرِ بنِ مَالِكِ بنِ النَّضْرِ بنِ كِنَانَةَ بنِ خُزَيْمَةَ بنِ مُدْرِكَةَ بنِ إِلْيَاسَ ابنِ مُضَرَ بنِ نِزَارِ بنِ مَعَدِّ بنِ عَدْنَانَ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ man bihi syarrafakum wa rafa`akumullâh, jaddikumul-mushthafal-mujtabâ: Muhammadi bni `Abdillâhi bni `Abdil-Muththalibi bni Hâsyimi bni `Abdi Manâfi bni Qushayyi bni Hakîmi bni Murrata bni Ka`bi bni Lu'ayyi bni Ghâlibi bni Fihri bni Mâliki bnin-Nadhri bni Kinânata bni Khuzaymata bni Mudrikata bni Ilyâsa bni Mudhara bni Nizâri bni Ma`addi bni `Adnân.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas dia yang dengannya Allah memuliakan dan meninggikan kalian: kakekmu yang terpilih lagi terpilih ﷺ — Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Abdul Muththalib bin Hasyim bin Abdu Manaf bin Qushay bin Hakim bin Murrah bin Ka'b bin Lu'ay bin Ghalib bin Fihr bin Malik bin an-Nadhr bin Kinanah bin Khuzaimah bin Mudrikah bin Ilyas bin Mudhar bin Nizar bin Ma'add bin Adnan.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, and upon the one through whom Allah honoured and elevated you: your grandfather, the chosen and elect ﷺ — Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Abdul-Muttalib bin Hashim bin Abd Manaf bin Qusayy bin Hakim bin Murrah bin Ka'b bin Lu'ayy bin Ghalib bin Fihr bin Malik bin an-Nadr bin Kinanah bin Khuzaymah bin Mudrikah bin Ilyas bin Mudar bin Nizar bin Ma'add bin Adnan.

passages.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُه وعلى أبيكم عبد اللَّه بن عبد المُطّلب بن هاشم بن عبد مناف. وعلى أُمِّكم سيّدتنا آمنةَ بنتِ وَهْب بن عبد مناف بن زُهْرَةَ بن حكيم بن مُرَّةَ بن كعب بن لُؤَيٍّ بن غَالِب.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ abîkum `Abdillâhi bni `Abdil-Muththalibi bni Hâsyimi bni `Abdi Manâf. Wa `alâ ummikum sayyidatinâ Âminata binti Wahbi bni `Abdi Manâfi bni Zuhrata bni Hakîmi bni Murrata bni Ka`bi bni Lu'ayyi bni Ghâlib.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas ayahnya, Abdullah bin Abdul Muththalib bin Hasyim bin Abdu Manaf; dan atas ibunya, junjungan kami Aminah binti Wahb bin Abdu Manaf bin Zuhrah bin Hakim bin Murrah bin Ka'b bin Lu'ay bin Ghalib.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, and upon his father Abdullah bin Abdul-Muttalib bin Hashim bin Abd Manaf; and upon his mother, our lady Aminah bint Wahb bin Abd Manaf bin Zuhrah bin Hakim bin Murrah bin Ka'b bin Lu'ayy bin Ghalib.

passages.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُه وعلى أولادِكم الغُرِّ المَيَامِين: القَاسِمِ، وعبدِ اللَّه "الطيّب الطاهر"، وَإبراهيمَ، وزينبَ، ورُقَيَّةَ، وأُمِّ كُلْثُوم، وأُمِّكُم البَتُول سيّدَتِنَا فَاطمةَ الزَّهْرَاءِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ aulâdikumul-ghurril-mayâmîn: al-Qâsimi, wa `Abdillâhith-thayyibith-thâhir, wa Ibrâhîma, wa Zaynaba, wa Ruqayyata, wa Ummi Kultsûm, wa ummikumul-batûli sayyidatinâ Fâthimataz-Zahrâ'.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas putra-putri beliau yang cemerlang lagi diberkahi: al-Qasim, Abdullah — ath-Thayyib ath-Thahir — Ibrahim, Zainab, Ruqayyah, dan Ummu Kultsum, serta ibundamu al-Batul, junjungan kami Fathimah az-Zahra.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, and upon his radiant, blessed children: al-Qasim, Abdullah — at-Tayyib at-Tahir — Ibrahim, Zaynab, Ruqayyah, and Umm Kulthum, and upon your mother, the chaste one, our lady Fatimah az-Zahra.

passages.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُه وعلى سادتِنا أبي طالب، والحمزة، والعبّاس، وعاتكةَ، وصفيةَ، وأروَى بني عبدِ المُطّلب بنِ هاشم بن عبد مناف.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ sâdatinâ Abî Thâlib, wal-Hamzata, wal-`Abbâs, wa `Âtikata, wa Shafiyyata, wa Arwâ banî `Abdil-Muththalibi bni Hâsyimi bni `Abdi Manâf.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas junjungan kami Abu Thalib, Hamzah, dan al-Abbas, serta Atikah, Shafiyyah, dan Arwa — putra-putri Abdul Muththalib bin Hasyim bin Abdu Manaf.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, and upon our masters Abu Talib, Hamzah, and al-Abbas, and Atikah, Safiyyah, and Arwa — the children of Abdul-Muttalib bin Hashim bin Abd Manaf.

passages.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُه وعلى أولادِكم الغُرِّ المَيامِين.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ aulâdikumul-ghurril-mayâmîn.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas anak-anakmu yang cemerlang lagi diberkahi.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, and upon your radiant, blessed children.

passages.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُه وعلى سادتنا أبي بكر وعمر وعثمان وعليّ. وعلى سيّدنا جعفر بن أبي طالب وعقيل بن أبي طالب، وأولاد سيّدي جعفر وأحفادِهم وأسباطهم.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ sâdatinâ Abî Bakrin wa `Umara wa `Utsmâna wa `Aliyy. Wa `alâ sayyidinâ Ja`fari bni Abî Thâlib wa `Aqîli bni Abî Thâlib, wa aulâdi sayyidî Ja`far wa ahfâdihim wa asbâthihim.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas junjungan kami Abu Bakar, Umar, Utsman, dan Ali; dan atas junjungan kami Ja'far bin Abi Thalib dan Aqil bin Abi Thalib, beserta putra-putra sayyidi Ja'far, cucu-cucu, dan keturunan mereka.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, and upon our masters Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, and Ali; and upon our master Ja'far bin Abi Talib and Aqil bin Abi Talib, and the children of my master Ja'far, their grandchildren, and their descendants.

passages.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُه وعلى جميع ذرّيتِكم الغَرَّاءِ، السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُه وعلى أُصُولِهِم وفُرُوعِهِم، السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُه وعلى مَن والاكُم في اللَّهِ، ومَن أَحَبَّكم في اللَّه.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ jamî`i dzurriyyatikumul-gharrâ'. As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ ushûlihim wa furû`ihim. As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ man wâlâkum fillâhi, wa man ahabbakum fillâh.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas seluruh keturunanmu yang cemerlang; atas para leluhur dan keturunan mereka; dan atas siapa saja yang setia kepada kalian karena Allah dan mencintai kalian karena Allah.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, and upon all your illustrious descendants; and upon their forebears and their progeny; and upon everyone loyal to you for Allah's sake, and everyone who loves you for Allah's sake.

passages.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُه وعلى سيّدنا قُطْبِ الزَّمَانِ، السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُه وعلى ساداتِنا آل باعلوي الأكرمين.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ sayyidinâ quthbiz-zamân. As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ sâdâtinâ Âli Bâ`alawil-akramîn.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas junjungan kami quthub zaman; dan atas junjungan kami keluarga Ba Alawi yang termulia.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, and upon our master, the spiritual pole of the age; and upon our most noble masters, the Al Ba Alawi.

passages.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُه وعلى سيّدنا عليّ زين العابدين وإخوانه، وعلى سيّدنا محمد الباقر وجعفر الصّادق وموسى الكاظم وعلي الرضا وعليّ العريضي ومحمد النقيب، وسيّدنا المُهاجر الى اللَّه أحمد بن عيسى، وأولاده عبيد اللَّه، وإخوانه بصري وجديد، وعلى سيّدنا محمد ابن علي صاحب مرباط، وعليّ بن علوي خالع قسم، وأولاده عليّ وعلوي ومحمّد وعبد اللَّه، وعلى الأستاذ الأعظم الفقيه المُقدّم محمّد بن عليّ باعلوي، وأولادهم، وأصولهم وفروعهم، وقربهم ومددهم، وعلى سيّدنا محمّد مولى الدَّويلة، وعلى سيّدنا الشَّيخ عبد الرّحمن السَّقاف، وعلى سيّدنا علي بن محمّد بن جديد، وعلى سيّدنا أبي بكر السكران وعمر المِحضار وعبد اللَّه وأحمد وحسين ومحسن، وعلى جميع أولاد سيّدنا السّقاف.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ sayyidinâ `Aliyyin Zaynil-`âbidîna wa ikhwânih, wa `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadinil-Bâqiri wa Ja`farish-Shâdiqi wa Mûsal-Kâzhimi wa `Aliyyir-Ridhâ wa `Aliyyinil-`Uraydhî wa Muhammadinin-Naqîb, wa sayyidinal-Muhâjiri ilallâhi Ahmada bni `Îsâ, wa aulâdihi `Ubaydillâh, wa ikhwânihi Bashriyyin wa Jadîd, wa `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadi bni `Aliyyin Shâhibi Mirbâth, wa `Aliyyi bni `Alawiyyin Khâli`i Qasam, wa aulâdihi `Aliyyin wa `Alawiyyin wa Muhammadin wa `Abdillâh, wa `alal-ustâdzil-a`zhamil-Faqîhil-Muqaddami Muhammadi bni `Aliyyin Bâ`alawî, wa aulâdihim, wa ushûlihim wa furû`ihim, wa qurbihim wa madadihim, wa `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin Maulad-Dawîlah, wa `alâ sayyidinasy-Syaykhi `Abdir-Rahmânis-Saqqâf, wa `alâ sayyidinâ `Aliyyi bni Muhammadi bni Jadîd, wa `alâ sayyidinâ Abî Bakrinis-Sakrâni wa `Umaral-Mihdhâri wa `Abdillâhi wa Ahmada wa Husaynin wa Muhsin, wa `alâ jamî`i aulâdi sayyidinas-Saqqâf.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas junjungan kami Ali Zainal Abidin beserta saudara-saudaranya; junjungan kami Muhammad al-Baqir, Ja'far ash-Shadiq, Musa al-Kazhim, Ali ar-Ridha, Ali al-Uraidhi, dan Muhammad an-Naqib; junjungan kami al-Muhajir ilallah Ahmad bin Isa, putranya Ubaidillah, dan saudara-saudaranya Bashri dan Jadid; junjungan kami Muhammad bin Ali Shahib Mirbath dan Ali bin Alwi Khali' Qasam beserta putra-putranya Ali, Alwi, Muhammad, dan Abdullah; sang guru teragung al-Faqih al-Muqaddam Muhammad bin Ali Ba Alawi, beserta anak-anak, leluhur dan keturunan mereka, kedekatan dan madad mereka; junjungan kami Muhammad Maula ad-Dawilah; junjungan kami Syekh Abdurrahman as-Saqqaf; junjungan kami Ali bin Muhammad bin Jadid; junjungan kami Abu Bakar as-Sakran, Umar al-Mihdhar, Abdullah, Ahmad, Husain, dan Muhsin; serta seluruh putra junjungan kami as-Saqqaf.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, and upon our master Ali Zayn al-Abidin and his brothers; upon our masters Muhammad al-Baqir, Ja'far as-Sadiq, Musa al-Kazim, Ali ar-Rida, Ali al-Uraydi, and Muhammad an-Naqib; our master al-Muhajir ilAllah Ahmad bin Isa, his son Ubaydullah, and his brothers Basri and Jadid; our master Muhammad bin Ali, Sahib Mirbat, and Ali bin Alawi, Khali' Qasam, and his sons Ali, Alawi, Muhammad, and Abdullah; the greatest teacher, al-Faqih al-Muqaddam Muhammad bin Ali Ba Alawi, and their children, their forebears and progeny, their nearness and support; our master Muhammad Mawla ad-Dawilah; our master Shaykh Abdurrahman as-Saqqaf; our master Ali bin Muhammad bin Jadid; our masters Abu Bakr as-Sakran, Umar al-Mihdar, Abdullah, Ahmad, Husayn, and Muhsin; and all the children of our master as-Saqqaf.

passages.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وعلى سيّدنا محمّد بن عليّ مولى عيديد، وعلى سيّدنا محمد بن حسن جمل اللّيل، وعلى سيّدنا محمد بو مُرَيِّم.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadi bni `Aliyyin Maulâ `Aydîd, wa `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadi bni Hasanin Jamalil-Layl, wa `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammad Bû Murayyim.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu, dan atas junjungan kami Muhammad bin Ali Maula Aidid; junjungan kami Muhammad bin Hasan Jamalullail; dan junjungan kami Muhammad Bu Murayyim.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and upon our master Muhammad bin Ali, Mawla Aydid; upon our master Muhammad bin Hasan Jamal al-Layl; and upon our master Muhammad Bu Murayyim.

passages.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وعلى سيّدنا شهاب الدين، وعلى سيّدنا الشيخ أبي بكر بن سالم وابنه الحسين وعمر محضار وحامد.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa `alâ sayyidinâ Syihâbid-dîn, wa `alâ sayyidinasy-Syaykhi Abî Bakri bni Sâlim wabnihil-Husayni wa `Umara Mihdhâr wa Hâmid.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu, dan atas junjungan kami Syihabuddin, dan atas junjungan kami Syekh Abu Bakar bin Salim beserta putra-putranya al-Husain, Umar Mihdhar, dan Hamid.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and upon our master Shihabuddin, and upon our master Shaykh Abu Bakr bin Salim and his sons al-Husayn, Umar Mihdar, and Hamid.

passages.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وعلى سيّدنا الإمام الحدّاد، السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وعلى سيّدنا الحبيب عبد القادر بن أحمد السّقاف، وجميع ساداتنا آل باعلوي، وآل بيت النّبوّة.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa `alâ sayyidinal-Imâmil-Haddâd. As-salâmu `alaykum wa `alâ sayyidinal-Habîbi `Abdil-Qâdiri bni Ahmadas-Saqqâf, wa jamî`i sâdâtinâ Âli Bâ`alawî, wa âli baytin-nubuwwah.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu, dan atas junjungan kami Imam al-Haddad. Salam sejahtera atasmu, dan atas junjungan kami Habib Abdul Qadir bin Ahmad as-Saqqaf, seluruh junjungan kami keluarga Ba Alawi, dan Ahlul Bait kenabian.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and upon our master Imam al-Haddad. Peace be upon you, and upon our master Habib Abdul Qadir bin Ahmad as-Saqqaf, and all our masters of the Al Ba Alawi, and the Household of Prophethood.

passages.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وعلى أولياء اللَّه أجمعين، السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وعلى والدينا، ومشايخِنا في اللَّهِ، وذوي الحقوقِ علينا أجمعين خاصّة.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa `alâ auliyâ'illâhi ajma`în. As-salâmu `alaykum wa `alâ wâlidînâ, wa masyâyikhinâ fillâh, wa dzawil-huqûqi `alaynâ ajma`îna khâsshah.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu, dan atas seluruh wali Allah. Salam sejahtera atasmu, dan atas kedua orang tua kami, guru-guru kami di jalan Allah, serta khususnya semua yang memiliki hak atas kami.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and upon all the friends of Allah. Peace be upon you, and upon our parents, our teachers in Allah, and especially all those who hold rights over us.

passages.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُه وعلى ساداتِنا الأنبياءِ: آدم وإدريس ونوح وهود وصالح وإبراهيم وموسى وعيسى، ومِن بَيْنِهِم سيّد المُرسلين، صلواتُ اللَّه وسلامُه عليه وعليكم أجمعين.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ sâdâtinal-anbiyâ': Âdama wa Idrîsa wa Nûhin wa Hûdin wa Shâlihin wa Ibrâhîma wa Mûsâ wa `Îsâ, wa min baynihim sayyidil-mursalîn, shalawâtullâhi wa salâmuhu `alayhi wa `alaykum ajma`în.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas junjungan kami para nabi: Adam, Idris, Nuh, Hud, Shalih, Ibrahim, Musa, dan Isa — dan di antara mereka penghulu para rasul. Shalawat dan salam Allah atas beliau dan atas kalian semua.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, and upon our masters the Prophets: Adam, Idris, Nuh, Hud, Salih, Ibrahim, Musa, and Isa — and among them the Master of the Messengers. May Allah's prayers and peace be upon him and upon you all.

passages.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُه وعلى ساداتنا: جبرائيل وميكائيل وإسرافيل وعزرائيل، ومنكر ونكير، ورقيب وعتيد، ومالك ورضوان، وجميع ملائكة اللَّه أجمعين، وجميع أصحاب سيّدنا المُصطفى محمد ﷺ وجميع أصحاب النبيّين.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ sâdâtinâ: Jibrâ'îla wa Mîkâ'îla wa Isrâfîla wa `Izrâ'îl, wa Munkirin wa Nakîr, wa Raqîbin wa `Atîd, wa Mâlikin wa Ridhwân, wa jamî`i malâ'ikatillâhi ajma`în, wa jamî`i ashhâbi sayyidinal-mushthafâ Muhammadin wa jamî`i ashhâbin-nabiyyîn.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas junjungan kami: Jibril, Mikail, Israfil, Izrail, Munkar, Nakir, Raqib, Atid, Malik, dan Ridwan, serta seluruh malaikat Allah; seluruh sahabat junjungan kami al-Musthafa Muhammad ﷺ, dan seluruh sahabat para nabi.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, and upon our masters: Jibril, Mikail, Israfil, Azrail, Munkar, Nakir, Raqib, Atid, Malik, and Ridwan, and all the angels of Allah; and all the Companions of our master, the chosen Muhammad ﷺ, and all the companions of the Prophets.

passages.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُه وعلى جميع آل سيدنا محمد ﷺ وآل النبيّين، وجميع عباد اللَّه الصالحين.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ jamî`i âli sayyidinâ Muhammadin wa âlin-nabiyyîn, wa jamî`i `ibâdillâhish-shâlihîn.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas seluruh keluarga junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad ﷺ dan keluarga para nabi, serta seluruh hamba Allah yang saleh.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, and upon the entire Family of our master Muhammad ﷺ and the families of the Prophets, and all the righteous servants of Allah.

passages.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُه عدد خلقِهِ، ورضى نفسِهِ، وزنة عرشِهِ، ومداد كلماتِهِ. دارَ قومٍ مؤمنين، أتاكم ما توعدون، غدًا مُؤَجَّلون، وإنَّا -إِنْ شاء اللَّهُ- بكم لاحقون، يرحم اللَّهُ المُسْتَقْدِمِين منكم والمُسْتَأْخرين، نسأل اللَّه لنا ولكم العافيةَ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu `adada khalqihi, wa ridhâ nafsihi, wa zinata `arsyihi, wa midâda kalimâtih. Dâra qaumin mu'minîn, atâkum mâ tû`adûn, ghadan mu'ajjalûn, wa innâ -insyâ Allâhu- bikum lâhiqûn, yarhamullâhul-mustaqdimîna minkum wal-musta'khirîn, nas'alullâha lanâ wa lakumul-`âfiyah.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya — sejumlah ciptaan-Nya, seluas keridhaan-Nya, seberat Arasy-Nya, dan sebanyak tinta firman-firman-Nya. Wahai penghuni negeri kaum beriman: telah datang kepada kalian apa yang dijanjikan; esok hanyalah waktu yang ditangguhkan, dan kami — insya Allah — akan menyusul kalian. Semoga Allah merahmati yang mendahului di antara kalian dan yang datang kemudian. Kami memohon kepada Allah keselamatan bagi kami dan bagi kalian.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings — by the number of His creation, the extent of His good-pleasure, the weight of His Throne, and the ink of His words. O abode of believing people: what you were promised has come to you; tomorrow is but deferred, and we — if Allah wills — shall join you. May Allah have mercy on those of you who went ahead and those who follow after. We ask Allah for wellbeing, for us and for you.

passages.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يا أهلَ لا إله إلا اللَّه مِن أهل لا إله إلا اللَّه، كيف وجدتم: لا إله إلا اللَّه؟
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum yâ ahla lâ ilâha illallâh min ahli lâ ilâha illallâh, kayfa wajadtum lâ ilâha illallâh?
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian, wahai ahli la ilaha illallah, dari ahli la ilaha illallah: bagaimana kalian mendapati la ilaha illallah?
passages.en: Peace be upon you, O people of la ilaha illallah, from people of la ilaha illallah: how have you found la ilaha illallah?

passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بحق لا إله إلا اللَّه اغفر لنا، ولكلّ من قال: لا إله إلا اللَّه. اللَّهُمَّ ربّ الباقيات أَخْرِجْنِي من الدّنيا بك مؤمنًا، وارزقنا رَوحًا مِنكَ، وسَلَامًا مِنَّا.
passages.tr: Allâhumma bihaqqi lâ ilâha illallâh, ighfir lanâ, wa likulli man qâla: lâ ilâha illallâh. Allâhumma rabbal-bâqiyâti akhrijnî minad-dunyâ bika mu'minâ, warzuqnâ rauhan minka, wa salâman minnâ.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, demi kebenaran la ilaha illallah, ampunilah kami dan setiap orang yang mengucapkan: la ilaha illallah. Ya Allah, Tuhan segala yang kekal, keluarkanlah aku dari dunia dalam keadaan beriman kepada-Mu, dan anugerahilah kami ketenteraman dari-Mu serta salam dari kami.
passages.en: O Allah, by the right of la ilaha illallah, forgive us and everyone who has said: la ilaha illallah. O Allah, Lord of the things that endure, take me out of this world believing in You, and grant us solace from You and greetings of peace from us.

passages.ar: ﴿سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكُم بِمَا صَبَرْتُمْ فَنِعْمَ عُقْبَى ٱلدَّارِ﴾ ﴿سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ طِبْتُمْ فَٱدْخُلُوهَا خَٰلِدِينَ﴾
passages.tr: Salâmun `alaykum bimâ shabartum fani`ma `uqbad-dâr. Salâmun `alaykum thibtum fadkhulûhâ khâlidîn.
passages.id_: "Salam sejahtera atas kalian karena kesabaran kalian — maka alangkah baiknya tempat kesudahan itu." [Surah ar-Ra'd 13:24] "Salam sejahtera atas kalian; kalian telah berbuat baik, maka masuklah ke dalamnya, kekal selamanya." [Surah az-Zumar 39:73]
passages.en: "Peace be upon you for your patient endurance — how excellent is the final abode!" [Surah ar-Ra'd 13:24] "Peace be upon you; you have done well, so enter it, abiding forever." [Surah az-Zumar 39:73]

passages.ar: ﴿قَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَبَانَا ٱسْتَغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا خَٰطِـِٔينَ﴾ (ثلاثًا) ﴿يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ مَسَّنَا وَأَهْلَنَا ٱلضُّرُّ وَجِئْنَا بِبِضَٰعَةٍ مُّزْجَىٰةٍ فَأَوْفِ لَنَا ٱلْكَيْلَ وَتَصَدَّقْ عَلَيْنَآ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَجْزِى ٱلْمُتَصَدِّقِينَ﴾
passages.tr: Qâlû yâ abânas-taghfir lanâ dzunûbanâ innâ kunnâ khâthi'în (3x). Yâ ayyuhal-`azîzu massanâ wa ahlanadh-dhurru wa ji'nâ bibidhâ`atin muzjâtin fa aufi lanal-kayla wa tashaddaq `alaynâ, innallâha yajzil-mutashaddiqîn.
passages.id_: "Mereka berkata: Wahai ayah kami, mohonkanlah ampunan atas dosa-dosa kami; sesungguhnya kami adalah orang-orang yang bersalah." [Surah Yusuf 12:97] (3 kali) "Wahai al-Aziz, kami dan keluarga kami ditimpa kesengsaraan dan kami datang membawa barang yang tak berharga — maka penuhilah takaran untuk kami dan bersedekahlah kepada kami; sesungguhnya Allah membalas orang-orang yang bersedekah." [Surah Yusuf 12:88]
passages.en: "They said: O our father, ask forgiveness for our sins; truly we have been sinners." [Surah Yusuf 12:97] (three times) "O mighty one, hardship has touched us and our family, and we come with meagre goods — so give us full measure and be charitable to us; truly Allah rewards the charitable." [Surah Yusuf 12:88]

passages.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُه عدد ما خلق، ومِلء ما خلق، وعدد ما في الأرض والسّماوات، ومِلء ما في الأرض والسّماوات، عدد ما أحصى كتابه، ومِلء ما أحصى كتابه، عدد كلِّ شيء، ومِلء كلِّ شيء.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu `adada mâ khalaq, wa mil'a mâ khalaq, wa `adada mâ fil-ardhi was-samâwât, wa mil'a mâ fil-ardhi was-samâwât, `adada mâ ahshâ kitâbuh, wa mil'a mâ ahshâ kitâbuh, `adada kulli syay'in, wa mil'a kulli syay'.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya — sejumlah apa yang Ia ciptakan dan sepenuh apa yang Ia ciptakan; sejumlah apa yang ada di bumi dan di langit dan sepenuh apa yang ada di bumi dan di langit; sejumlah apa yang tercatat dalam kitab-Nya dan sepenuh apa yang tercatat dalam kitab-Nya; sejumlah segala sesuatu dan sepenuh segala sesuatu.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings — by the number of what He created and the fullness of what He created; by the number of what is in the earth and the heavens and the fullness of what is in the earth and the heavens; by the number of what His Book has recorded and the fullness of what His Book has recorded; by the number of all things and the fullness of all things.

passages.ar: كل سلام مِن ذلك يجمع اللَّه لنا به ما كانَ، وما يكونُ في زيارة أهل الخيرِ، وفي زيارتكم لهذا المَكان، وحظ مَن يأتي وسيجيء مِن عفوه ومغفرته وجوده وقربه ورضوانه وإحسانه، وتَعَرُّفِهِ إلى عبادِه، ونَيْلِ الوِدَادِ مِن حَضْرَتِهِ العَلِيَّةِ بِالنُّصْرَةِ والتَّأْييدِ والتَّسْدِيدِ، والصدقِ، والمَعرفةِ، والذّكرِ، والبركة من كل جانب، يجمع اللَّه لنا بهما ما تَفَرَّقَ مِن زِيَادَةِ الخَيرَاتِ كُلِّهَا.
passages.tr: Kullu salâmin min dzâlika yajma`ullâhu lanâ bihi mâ kâna, wa mâ yakûnu fî ziyârati ahlil-khayr, wa fî ziyâratikum lihâdzal-makân, wa hazhzhi man ya'tî wa sayajî'u min `afwihi wa maghfiratihi wa jûdihi wa qurbihi wa ridhwânihi wa ihsânih, wa ta`arrufihi ilâ `ibâdih, wa naylil-widâdi min hadhratihil-`aliyyati bin-nushrati wat-ta'yîdi wat-tasdîd, wash-shidqi, wal-ma`rifati, wadz-dzikri, wal-barakati min kulli jânib, yajma`ullâhu lanâ bihimâ mâ tafarraqa min ziyâdatil-khayrâti kullihâ.
passages.id_: Dengan setiap salam itu, semoga Allah menghimpunkan bagi kami segala yang telah dan akan ada dalam ziarah kepada ahli kebaikan, dan dalam ziarah kalian di tempat ini; bagian setiap orang yang datang dan yang akan datang dari maaf-Nya, ampunan-Nya, kedermawanan-Nya, kedekatan-Nya, keridhaan-Nya, dan kebaikan-Nya; pengenalan-Nya kepada hamba-hamba-Nya; serta perolehan cinta dari hadirat-Nya yang luhur — dengan pertolongan, dukungan, bimbingan, kejujuran, makrifat, zikir, dan berkah dari segala penjuru. Semoga Allah menghimpunkan bagi kami segala tambahan kebaikan yang tercerai-berai.
passages.en: With every one of these greetings, may Allah gather for us all that has been and all that shall be in the visiting of the people of goodness, and in your visitation at this place; and the portion of all who come and are yet to come of His pardon, His forgiveness, His generosity, His nearness, His good-pleasure, and His beneficence; His making Himself known to His servants; and the attainment of loving intimacy from His exalted presence — with succour, support, right guidance, truthfulness, knowledge of Him, remembrance, and blessing from every side. May Allah gather for us thereby every scattered increase of good.

passages.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُه ملء ذلك كلّه، يفتح اللَّه لنا به وللمسلمين أبوابَ الفرج، ويرفع به الضيق والحرجَ، ويُديم به الأمن والأمان والاستقرارَ في هذه الربوع، وديارنا وديار المُسلمين، ويرفع به البَلَايا عنّا وعن المُؤمنين.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu mil'a dzâlika kullih, yaftahullâhu lanâ bihi wa lil-muslimîna abwâbal-faraj, wa yarfa`u bihidh-dhîqa wal-haraj, wa yudîmu bihil-amna wal-amâna wal-istiqrâra fî hâdzihir-rubû`, wa diyârinâ wa diyâril-muslimîn, wa yarfa`u bihil-balâyâ `annâ wa `anil-mu'minîn.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, sepenuh itu semua — yang dengannya Allah membukakan bagi kami dan kaum muslimin pintu-pintu kelapangan, mengangkat kesempitan dan kesukaran, melanggengkan keamanan, ketenteraman, dan kestabilan di bumi ini, di negeri kami dan negeri kaum muslimin, serta mengangkat segala bala dari kami dan dari kaum mukminin.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, filling all of that — by which Allah opens for us and for the Muslims the gates of relief, lifts away constriction and hardship, makes lasting the safety, security, and stability of these lands and of our homes and the homes of the Muslims, and removes tribulations from us and from the believers.

passages.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُه مثل ذلك كله، عدد خلقهِ، ورضى نفسهِ، وزنة عرشهِ، ومداد كلماتهِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu mitsla dzâlika kullih, `adada khalqihi, wa ridhâ nafsihi, wa zinata `arsyihi, wa midâda kalimâtih.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, sebanding itu semua — sejumlah ciptaan-Nya, seluas keridhaan-Nya, seberat Arasy-Nya, dan sebanyak tinta firman-firman-Nya.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, the like of all of that — by the number of His creation, the extent of His good-pleasure, the weight of His Throne, and the ink of His words.

passages.ar: "التحياتُ المُباركاتُ الصَّلَواتُ الطيباتُ لِلَّهِ، السلام عليك أيُّهَا النّبيُّ ورحمة اللَّه وبركاته، السلام علينا وعلى عباد اللَّه الصالحين، أشهد ألّا إله إلا اللَّه وحدَهُ لا شريك له، وأشهد أن سيّدنا محمدًا عبدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ".
passages.tr: At-tahiyyâtul-mubârakâtush-shalawâtuth-thayyibâtu lillâh. As-salâmu `alayka ayyuhan-nabiyyu wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuh. As-salâmu `alaynâ wa `alâ `ibâdillâhish-shâlihîn. Asyhadu allâ ilâha illallâhu wahdahu lâ syarîka lah, wa asyhadu anna sayyidanâ Muhammadan `abduhu wa rasûluh.
passages.id_: "Segala penghormatan yang berkah dan shalawat yang baik adalah milik Allah. Salam sejahtera atasmu, wahai Nabi, beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya. Salam sejahtera atas kami dan atas hamba-hamba Allah yang saleh. Aku bersaksi bahwa tiada tuhan selain Allah semata, tiada sekutu bagi-Nya, dan aku bersaksi bahwa junjungan kami Muhammad adalah hamba dan utusan-Nya."
passages.en: "All blessed salutations and wholesome prayers belong to Allah. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and Allah's mercy and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah. I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, without partner, and I bear witness that our master Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger."

passages.ar: ﴿الٓمٓ ۝ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ هُدًى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ﴾ إلى ﴿ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ﴾
passages.tr: Alif lâm mîm. Dzâlikal-kitâbu lâ rayba fîhi hudan lil-muttaqîn — ilâ — al-muflihûn.
passages.id_: Bacalah: "Alif Lam Mim. Kitab itu tidak ada keraguan padanya, petunjuk bagi orang-orang yang bertakwa…" sampai "…merekalah orang-orang yang beruntung" [Surah al-Baqarah 2:1–5].
passages.en: Recite: "Alif Lam Mim. That is the Book in which there is no doubt, a guidance for the God-fearing…" up to "…they are the successful" [Surah al-Baqarah 2:1–5].

passages.id_: Kemudian membaca:
passages.en: Then recite:

passages.ar: سورة الكوثر (ثلاثًا). سورة الكافرون. سورة النصر. سورة المَسد. سورة الإخلاص (ثلاثًا). سورة الفلق. سورة الناس.
passages.tr: Sûratul-Kautsar (3x). Sûratul-Kâfirûn. Sûratun-Nashr. Sûratul-Masad. Sûratul-Ikhlâsh (3x). Sûratul-Falaq. Sûratun-Nâs.
passages.id_: Surah al-Kautsar (3 kali); Surah al-Kafirun; Surah an-Nashr; Surah al-Masad; Surah al-Ikhlas (3 kali); Surah al-Falaq; Surah an-Nas.
passages.en: Surah al-Kawthar (three times); Surah al-Kafirun; Surah an-Nasr; Surah al-Masad; Surah al-Ikhlas (three times); Surah al-Falaq; Surah an-Nas.

passages.ar: قصيدة "إلهي نسألك بالاسم الأعظم"، البداية بـ: بكل طوائفِ الأملاكِ نَدْعُو * بما في غيبِ ربي أجمعينا. وفي نيل المطالب والأماني * وكشف الضر قَدَّمْنَا الحُسَينا (٣)
passages.tr: Qashîdah "Ilâhî nas'aluka bil-ismil-a`zham", dimulai dengan: Bikulli thawâ'ifil-amlâki nad`û * bimâ fî ghaybi rabbî ajma`înâ. Wa fî naylil-mathâlibi wal-amânî * wa kasyfidh-dhurri qaddamnal-Husaynâ (3x).
passages.id_: Qasidah "Ilahi nas'aluka bil-ismil-a'zham", dimulai dengan: "Dengan segenap golongan malaikat kami berdoa, dan dengan segala yang ada dalam kegaiban Tuhanku; dan demi tercapainya permohonan dan harapan, serta tersingkapnya mudarat, kami menghadapkan al-Husain" (3 kali).
passages.en: The qasidah "Ilahi nas'aluka bil-ismil-a'zam", beginning: "By all the ranks of angels we call, and by all that lies in my Lord's unseen; and for the attainment of requests and hopes, and the lifting of harm, we put forward al-Husayn" (three times).

passages.ar: قصيدة "يا عالم السر منّا"، البداية بـ: قد استعنتك ربي * على مداواة قلبي ...إلخ. قصيدة "يا أرحم الراحمين"، البداية بـ: ربِّ أحينا شاكرين * وتوفنا مسلمين ...إلخ. قصيدة "رب إني يا ذا الصفات العلية" ...إلخ.
passages.tr: Qashîdah "Yâ `âlimas-sirri minnâ", dimulai dengan: Qadis-ta`antuka rabbî * `alâ mudâwâti qalbî — dst. Qashîdah "Yâ arhamar-râhimîn", dimulai dengan: Rabbi ahyinâ syâkirîn * wa tawaffanâ muslimîn — dst. Qashîdah "Rabbi innî yâ dzash-shifâtil-`aliyyah" — dst.
passages.id_: Qasidah "Ya alimas-sirri minna", dimulai dengan: "Sungguh aku memohon pertolongan-Mu, Tuhanku, untuk mengobati hatiku…" (dst.); qasidah "Ya arhamar-rahimin", dimulai dengan: "Tuhanku, hidupkanlah kami dalam keadaan bersyukur, dan wafatkanlah kami dalam keadaan muslim…" (dst.); dan qasidah "Rabbi inni ya dzash-shifatil-aliyyah…" (dst.).
passages.en: The qasidah "Ya alimas-sirri minna", beginning: "I seek Your help, my Lord, in curing my heart…" (etc.); the qasidah "Ya arhamar-rahimin", beginning: "My Lord, keep us alive in gratitude, and take us in death as Muslims…" (etc.); and the qasidah "Rabbi inni ya dhas-sifatil-aliyyah…" (etc.).

passages.ar: برحمتك يا أرحم الراحمين، وجودك يا أجود الأجودين، اللَّهُمَّ اجعلها ساعَةً مِن ساعات القَبُولِ.
passages.tr: Birahmatika yâ arhamar-râhimîn, wa jûdika yâ ajwadal-ajwadîn, Allâhummaj`alhâ sâ`atan min sâ`âtil-qabûl.
passages.id_: Dengan rahmat-Mu, wahai Yang paling penyayang di antara para penyayang, dan kedermawanan-Mu, wahai Yang paling dermawan di antara para dermawan — ya Allah, jadikanlah saat ini termasuk saat-saat diterimanya doa.
passages.en: By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful, and Your generosity, O Most Generous of the generous — O Allah, make this an hour among the hours of acceptance.

passages.ar: وِرد الشيخ أبي بكر بن سالم "اللَّهُمَّ يا عظيم السلطان...".
passages.tr: Wirdusy-Syaykh Abî Bakr bin Sâlim "Allâhumma yâ `azhîmas-sulthân...".
passages.id_: Wirid Syekh Abu Bakar bin Salim: "Allahumma ya azhimas-sulthan…".
passages.en: The Wird of Shaykh Abu Bakr bin Salim: "Allahumma ya azimas-sultan…".

passages.ar: يا عمدتي يا عدتي * يا منقذي من شدتي. وجّهت لك وجهتي * عَجِّلْ بِغَوثِي يا عظيم، يا اللَّه. وسخّر الأسبابَ * وذلّل الصعابَ. وافتح لنا الأبوابَ * بالنصرِ مِنكَ يا كريم، يا اللَّه. وَرُدَّ كيدَ الكائدِ * وكل طاغٍ، ماردِ. وحاسدٍ، معاندِ * بحق سرّ ﴿طسٓمٓ﴾، يا اللَّه (٣)
passages.tr: Yâ `umdatî yâ `uddatî * yâ munqidzî min syiddatî. Wajjahtu laka wijhatî * `ajjil bighautsî yâ `Azhîm, yâ Allâh. Wa sakhkhiril-asbâba * wa dzallilish-shi`âb. Waftah lanal-abwâba * bin-nashri minka yâ Karîm, yâ Allâh. Wa rudda kaydal-kâ'idi * wa kulli thâghin mârid. Wa hâsidin mu`ânidin * bihaqqi sirri Thâ Sîn Mîm, yâ Allâh (3x).
passages.id_: Wahai sandaranku, wahai bekalku, wahai penyelamatku dari kesulitanku! Kuhadapkan wajahku kepada-Mu — segerakanlah pertolongan-Mu bagiku, wahai Yang Maha Agung, ya Allah. Tundukkanlah segala sebab dan mudahkanlah segala kesukaran; bukakanlah bagi kami pintu-pintu dengan kemenangan dari-Mu, wahai Yang Maha Mulia, ya Allah. Dan tolaklah tipu daya setiap pembuat makar, setiap orang lalim dan durjana, setiap pendengki dan pembangkang — demi rahasia Tha Sin Mim, ya Allah (3 kali).
passages.en: O my support, O my provision, O my rescuer from my distress! I have turned my face to You — hasten Your aid to me, O Mighty One, O Allah. Dispose the means and smooth the difficulties; open the doors for us with victory from You, O Generous One, O Allah. And turn back the plot of every plotter, every tyrant and rebel, every envier and obstinate foe — by the right of the secret of Ta Sin Mim, O Allah (three times).

passages.ar: اقْبَلْنَا في هذا المَقَامِ، وبَلِّغْنَا المَرامَ وفوقَ المَرَامِ، وأَوصِلْ ثَوَابَ مَا تَكَرَّمْتَ به علينا مضاعفًا إلى ما لا نهاية في كل لمْحةٍ ونَفَسٍ إلى رُوح حبيبك سيّدنا محمّد خير الأنام ﷺ، وإلى أرواح أولاده الكرام: القاسمِ، وعبد اللَّه "الطيّب والطّاهر"، وإبراهيم، وزينب، ورقية، وأم كلثوم، وسيّدتنا فاطمة الزهراء، وأولادها: ساداتنا الحسنِ، والحسينِ، ومُحْسِنٍ، وزَينبَ، وأُمِّ كُلْثُوم.
passages.tr: Iqbalnâ fî hâdzal-maqâm, wa ballighnal-marâma wa fauqal-marâm, wa aushil tsawâba mâ takarramta bihi `alaynâ mudhâ`afan ilâ mâ lâ nihâyata fî kulli lamhatin wa nafasin ilâ rûhi habîbika sayyidinâ Muhammadin khayril-anâm, wa ilâ arwâhi aulâdihil-kirâm: al-Qâsimi, wa `Abdillâhith-thayyibith-thâhir, wa Ibrâhîma, wa Zaynaba, wa Ruqayyata, wa Ummi Kultsûm, wa sayyidatinâ Fâthimataz-Zahrâ', wa aulâdihâ: sâdâtinal-Hasani, wal-Husayni, wa Muhsinin, wa Zaynaba, wa Ummi Kultsûm.
passages.id_: Terimalah kami di maqam ini, sampaikanlah kami pada tujuan dan melampaui tujuan, dan sampaikanlah pahala apa yang telah Engkau karuniakan kepada kami — berlipat tanpa batas, pada setiap kejapan mata dan hembusan napas — kepada ruh kekasih-Mu, junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad, sebaik-baik makhluk ﷺ; kepada arwah putra-putri beliau yang mulia: al-Qasim, Abdullah — ath-Thayyib ath-Thahir — Ibrahim, Zainab, Ruqayyah, dan Ummu Kultsum; serta junjungan kami Fathimah az-Zahra dan putra-putrinya: junjungan kami al-Hasan, al-Husain, Muhsin, Zainab, dan Ummu Kultsum.
passages.en: Accept us in this station, bring us to our goal and beyond it, and convey the reward of what You have graciously granted us — multiplied without end, in every instant and every breath — to the soul of Your beloved, our master Muhammad, the best of creation ﷺ; and to the souls of his noble children: al-Qasim, Abdullah — the good and the pure — Ibrahim, Zaynab, Ruqayyah, and Umm Kulthum; and our lady Fatimah az-Zahra and her children, our masters al-Hasan, al-Husayn, Muhsin, Zaynab, and Umm Kulthum.

passages.ar: وإلى أرواح ساداتنا آل بيتِ المُصطفى ﷺ، وصحابته الغرِّ المَيامين، ولا سيما: الخلفاء الراشدين، وأهل بيعة العقبة، وأهل بيعة الرّضوان، وأهل أحد، وسائر صحابته الأكرمين، وأهل بيته الطّاهرين، ومَن تَبِعَهُم بإحسان إلى يوم الدِّينِ، ومَن شملهم من التسليم عليهم في هذا المَقام، والأنبياء كافّة، وأهل قُرْبِكَ وأهل رضاك، وأوليائك أجمعين، ووالدينا ومشايخنا، وذوي الحقوق علينا خاصّة، وأمواتهم وأحيائهم، والمُسلمين عامة إلى يوم الدّين.
passages.tr: Wa ilâ arwâhi sâdâtinâ âli baytil-mushthafâ, wa shahâbatihil-ghurril-mayâmîn, wa lâ siyyamal-khulafâ'ir-râsyidîn, wa ahli bay`atil-`aqabah, wa ahli bay`atir-ridhwân, wa ahli Uhud, wa sâ'iri shahâbatihil-akramîn, wa ahli baytihith-thâhirîn, wa man tabi`ahum bi'ihsânin ilâ yaumid-dîn, wa man syamalahum minat-taslîmi `alayhim fî hâdzal-maqâm, wal-anbiyâ'i kâffah, wa ahli qurbika wa ahli ridhâka, wa auliyâ'ika ajma`în, wa wâlidînâ wa masyâyikhinâ, wa dzawil-huqûqi `alaynâ khâsshah, wa amwâtihim wa ahyâ'ihim, wal-muslimîna `âmmatan ilâ yaumid-dîn.
passages.id_: Dan kepada arwah junjungan kami Ahlul Bait al-Musthafa ﷺ dan para sahabat beliau yang cemerlang lagi diberkahi — terutama Khulafaur Rasyidin, ahli baiat Aqabah, ahli Baiat Ridwan, ahli Uhud, dan seluruh sahabat beliau yang termulia; Ahlul Bait beliau yang suci; mereka yang mengikuti dengan kebaikan hingga hari pembalasan; semua yang tercakup dalam salam kami di maqam ini; seluruh para nabi; ahli kedekatan dan keridhaan-Mu serta seluruh wali-Mu; kedua orang tua dan guru-guru kami, khususnya mereka yang memiliki hak atas kami, yang telah wafat maupun yang masih hidup; dan kaum muslimin seluruhnya hingga hari pembalasan.
passages.en: And to the souls of our masters, the Household of the Chosen One ﷺ, and his radiant, blessed Companions — above all the rightly-guided Caliphs, the people of the pledge of al-Aqabah, the people of the pledge of Ridwan, the people of Uhud, and all his most noble Companions; his pure Household; those who followed them in excellence until the Day of Judgement; all whom our greetings in this station embrace; all the Prophets; the people of Your nearness and Your good-pleasure and all Your friends; our parents and our teachers, and especially those who hold rights over us, their departed and their living; and the Muslims at large until the Day of Judgement.

passages.ar: واقبل الزّيارة، وعجّل بالبشارة، واختم بالطّهارة، وانظر إلينا في مجمعنا هذا في هذا المَقام الأشرف نظرةً تُنَقِّينَا بِهَا عَن جَمِيعِ الشَّوَائِبِ، وتَرْفَعُنا بِهَا إِلَى أعلى المَراتبِ، وتَهَبُ لنا بها أجزلَ المَواهبِ، بكل شأنٍ مِن الشُّؤون في الحاضر والعَوَاقبِ، تربطنا بها بأطيب الأطايب، وتسقينا بها من أحلى المَشارب، وتنيلنا بها أعلى مراتِبِ القُربِ مِنكَ، والدُّنُوِّ إليكَ، والفَهْمِ عنكَ، والمَعرفة بك، والأدب معك، والإخلاص لوجهك، والصِّدق معك، والوفاء بعهدك، الَّذِي عَاهَدْتَنَا عَلَيْهِ، يا أرحمَ الرّاحمين.
passages.tr: Waqbaliz-ziyârata, wa `ajjil bil-bisyârati, wakhtim bith-thahârah, wanzhur ilaynâ fî majma`inâ hâdzâ fî hâdzal-maqâmil-asyrafi nazhratan tunaqqînâ bihâ `an jamî`isy-syawâ'ib, wa tarfa`unâ bihâ ilâ a`lal-marâtib, wa tahabu lanâ bihâ ajzalal-mawâhib, bikulli sya'nin minasy-syu'ûni fil-hâdhiri wal-`awâqib, turbithunâ bihâ bi'athyabil-athâyib, wa tasqînâ bihâ min ahlal-masyârib, wa tunîlunâ bihâ a`lâ marâtibil-qurbi minka, wad-dunuwwi ilayka, wal-fahmi `anka, wal-ma`rifati bika, wal-adabi ma`aka, wal-ikhlâshi liwajhika, wash-shidqi ma`aka, wal-wafâ'i bi`ahdikal-ladzî `âhadtanâ `alayh, yâ arhamar-râhimîn.
passages.id_: Terimalah ziarah ini, segerakanlah kabar gembira, dan tutuplah hidup kami dengan kesucian. Pandanglah kami dalam perkumpulan kami ini, di maqam yang paling mulia ini, dengan pandangan yang dengannya Engkau bersihkan kami dari segala noda, Engkau angkat kami ke derajat tertinggi, dan Engkau anugerahkan kepada kami karunia yang paling melimpah dalam segala urusan, kini dan nanti; yang dengannya Engkau ikat kami dengan sebaik-baik kebaikan, Engkau beri kami minum dari semanis-manis minuman, dan Engkau sampaikan kami ke derajat kedekatan tertinggi dengan-Mu — kedekatan kepada-Mu, pemahaman dari-Mu, makrifat akan-Mu, adab bersama-Mu, keikhlasan demi wajah-Mu, kejujuran bersama-Mu, dan kesetiaan pada janji yang telah Engkau ambil dari kami — wahai Yang paling penyayang di antara para penyayang.
passages.en: Accept this visit, hasten the glad tidings, and seal our lives with purity. Look upon us in this our gathering, in this most noble station, with a gaze by which You cleanse us of every impurity, raise us to the highest ranks, and grant us the most abundant gifts in every matter, present and to come; by which You bind us to the finest of the pure, give us to drink of the sweetest draughts, and bring us to the highest degrees of nearness to You — of closeness to You, understanding from You, knowledge of You, right conduct with You, sincerity for Your sake, truthfulness with You, and faithfulness to the covenant You have taken from us — O Most Merciful of the merciful.

passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجعلنا في هذَا المَجْمَعِ مَقْبُوْلِينَ، وبِحَقِّ نَبِيِّكَ ﷺ مَوْصُوْلِينَ، وَلِكُلِّ خَيرٍ حَاوِينَ، ومِن كُلِّ شَرٍّ مَحفُوظِينَ ومَحرُوسِينَ بِعَينِ عِنَايَتِكَ، يا ربّ العالمِين.
passages.tr: Allâhummaj`alnâ fî hâdzal-majma`i maqbûlîn, wa bihaqqi nabiyyika maushûlîn, wa likulli khayrin hâwîn, wa min kulli syarrin mahfûzhîna wa mahrûsîna bi`ayni `inâyatika, yâ rabbal-`âlamîn.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, jadikanlah kami diterima dalam perkumpulan ini, tersambung demi hak Nabi-Mu ﷺ, menghimpun segala kebaikan, serta terpelihara dan terjaga dari segala keburukan dengan mata inayah-Mu, wahai Tuhan semesta alam.
passages.en: O Allah, make us accepted in this gathering, joined by the right of Your Prophet ﷺ, containing every good, and protected and guarded from every evil by the eye of Your care, O Lord of the worlds.

passages.ar: يا أوّلَ الأوّلينَ، ويا آخر الآخرينَ، ويا ذا القوّة المَتين، ويا راحم المَساكين، ويا أرحم الرّاحمين، اربطنا بسيّدنا الحسين، وإخوانه وأولاده، وأمه وأبيه، وجده المُصطفى ﷺ رَبْطًا لا ينحلّ أَبَدًا، واجعلنا بذلك مِن أسعد السُّعَدَا، هَهُنَا وَغَدًا.
passages.tr: Yâ awwalal-awwalîn, wa yâ âkhiral-âkhirîn, wa yâ dzal-quwwatil-matîn, wa yâ râhimal-masâkîn, wa yâ arhamar-râhimîn, urbuthnâ bisayyidinal-Husayn, wa ikhwânihi wa aulâdih, wa ummihi wa abîh, wa jaddihil-mushthafâ rabthan lâ yanhallu abadâ, waj`alnâ bidzâlika min as`adis-su`adâ, hâhunâ wa ghadâ.
passages.id_: Wahai Yang Awal dari segala yang awal dan Yang Akhir dari segala yang akhir, wahai Pemilik kekuatan yang kokoh, wahai Pengasih kaum papa, wahai Yang paling penyayang di antara para penyayang — ikatlah kami dengan junjungan kami al-Husain, saudara-saudara dan putra-putrinya, ibu dan ayahnya, serta kakeknya al-Musthafa ﷺ, dengan ikatan yang tak pernah terlepas selamanya; dan jadikanlah kami dengan itu termasuk sebahagia-bahagia orang, di sini dan di hari esok.
passages.en: O First of the first and Last of the last, O Possessor of firm strength, O Merciful to the destitute, O Most Merciful of the merciful — bind us to our master al-Husayn, his brothers and his children, his mother and his father, and his grandfather, the Chosen One ﷺ, with a bond that never comes undone; and make us thereby among the happiest of the happy, here and on the morrow.

passages.ar: وانظر به إلى أهل هذه البلدان ووادينا ونادينا، وإلى المُؤمنين والمُؤمنات نظرة تزيل العناء عنّا وعنهم، وتدني المُنَى مِنَّا ومِنْهُم، وكُل الهَنَا نُعْطَاهُ ويُعْطَونَه فِي كُلِّ حِينٍ. واكْشِفِ الكُرُوبَ، وادْفَعِ الخُطُوْبَ، وأَصْلِحِ القَوَالِبَ والقُلُوبَ.
passages.tr: Wanzhur bihi ilâ ahli hâdzihil-buldâni wa wâdînâ wa nâdînâ, wa ilal-mu'minîna wal-mu'minâti nazhratan tuzîlul-`anâ'a `annâ wa `anhum, wa tudnil-munâ minnâ wa minhum, wa kullal-hanâ nu`thâhu wa yu`thaunahu fî kulli hîn. Waksyifil-kurûba, wadfa`il-khuthûba, wa ashlihil-qawâliba wal-qulûb.
passages.id_: Dan melalui beliau, pandanglah penduduk negeri-negeri ini, lembah kami dan majelis kami, serta kaum mukminin dan mukminat, dengan pandangan yang menghilangkan kepayahan dari kami dan mereka, mendekatkan harapan kepada kami dan mereka, dan segala kebahagiaan kami dan mereka peroleh di setiap waktu. Singkapkanlah kesusahan, tolaklah bencana, dan perbaikilah jasad dan hati.
passages.en: And through him look upon the people of these lands, our valley and our gathering, and upon the believing men and women, with a gaze that removes weariness from us and from them, brings our hopes near to us and to them, and grants us and them every happiness at every moment. Lift away the sorrows, avert the calamities, and set right both bodies and hearts.

passages.ar: وائْذَنْ لنا بِنَظَرِ جَمَالِكَ الأَسْنَى، وشُهُودِكَ بِمِرْآةِ حَبِيبِكَ الأَصْفَى، وتَوَلَّنَا بِهِ في كُلِّ ظَاهِرٍ وفِي كُلِّ خَفِيٍّ، وامْنُنْ عَلَينَا بِكَمَالِ العَافِيَةِ والشفاء، وعلى جميع مرضانا ومرضَى المُسلِمِينَ في الظَاهِرِ والخفاء.
passages.tr: Wa'dzan lanâ binazhari jamâlikal-asnâ, wa syuhûdika bimir'âti habîbikal-ashfâ, wa tawallanâ bihi fî kulli zhâhirin wa fî kulli khafiyy, wamnun `alaynâ bikamâlil-`âfiyati wasy-syifâ', wa `alâ jamî`i mardhânâ wa mardhal-muslimîna fizh-zhâhiri wal-khafâ'.
passages.id_: Izinkanlah kami memandang keindahan-Mu yang paling cemerlang dan menyaksikan-Mu melalui cermin kekasih-Mu yang paling suci; uruslah kami melalui beliau dalam segala yang lahir dan yang tersembunyi; dan karuniakanlah kepada kami kesempurnaan afiat dan kesembuhan — juga kepada seluruh orang sakit kami dan orang sakit kaum muslimin, lahir maupun batin.
passages.en: Grant us leave to behold Your most radiant beauty and to witness You in the mirror of Your purest beloved; take charge of us through him in all that is outward and all that is hidden; and favour us with complete wellbeing and healing — and all our sick, and the sick of the Muslims, outwardly and inwardly.

passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وثبّتنا على حُسْنِ المُتَابَعَةِ والاقتِفَاء، وأَعِذْنَا مِن كل قاطع يقطعنا عنك، ومن كل حاجزٍ يحول بيننا وبينكَ، وبينَ رِضْوَانِك الأكبر وشهودِك الأسنى.
passages.tr: Allâhumma wa tsabbitnâ `alâ husnil-mutâba`ati wal-iqtifâ', wa a`idznâ min kulli qâthi`in yaqtha`unâ `anka, wa min kulli hâjizin yahûlu baynanâ wa baynaka, wa bayna ridhwânikal-akbari wa syuhûdikal-asnâ.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, teguhkanlah kami dalam mengikuti dan meneladani dengan baik, dan lindungilah kami dari segala pemutus yang memutuskan kami dari-Mu, dan dari segala penghalang yang menghalangi antara kami dan Engkau, dan antara kami dan keridhaan-Mu yang terbesar serta penyaksian-Mu yang paling cemerlang.
passages.en: O Allah, make us firm in beautifully following and treading his path, and protect us from everything that would sever us from You, and from every barrier that would come between us and You, and between us and Your greatest good-pleasure and the most radiant witnessing of You.

passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ تولّنا حيثما كنّا، وأينَ ما كنّا، ولا تكلنا الى أنفسنا ولا إلى أحد مِن خَلْقِكَ طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma tawallanâ haytsumâ kunnâ, wa ayna mâ kunnâ, wa lâ takilnâ ilâ anfusinâ wa lâ ilâ ahadin min khalqika tharfata `ayn.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, uruslah kami di mana pun kami berada, dan janganlah Engkau serahkan kami kepada diri kami sendiri, atau kepada salah satu makhluk-Mu, walau sekejap mata.
passages.en: O Allah, take charge of us wherever we are, and do not entrust us to ourselves nor to any of Your creation for even the blink of an eye.

passages.ar: واجعل مُسْتَقَرَّ العلمِ النَّافع قُلُوبَنَا، وَمُسْتَقَرَّ أربابه ديارنا، ومستقرّ المَعرفة باللَّه قلوبنا، ومستقرّ أربابها ديارنا، وَمُسْتَقَرَّ الورع الحاجز قلوبنا، وَمُسْتَقَرَّ أربابه ديارنا، ومستقرّ اليقين التام قلوبنا، وَمُسْتَقَرَّ أربابه ديارنا.
passages.tr: Waj`al mustaqarral-`ilmin-nâfi`i qulûbanâ, wa mustaqarra arbâbihi diyâranâ, wa mustaqarral-ma`rifati billâhi qulûbanâ, wa mustaqarra arbâbihâ diyâranâ, wa mustaqarral-wara`il-hâjizi qulûbanâ, wa mustaqarra arbâbihi diyâranâ, wa mustaqarral-yaqînit-tâmmi qulûbanâ, wa mustaqarra arbâbihi diyâranâ.
passages.id_: Jadikanlah hati kami tempat bersemayamnya ilmu yang bermanfaat, dan rumah-rumah kami tempat bersemayamnya para ahlinya; hati kami tempat bersemayamnya makrifat kepada Allah, dan rumah-rumah kami tempat para ahlinya; hati kami tempat bersemayamnya wara yang membentengi, dan rumah-rumah kami tempat para ahlinya; hati kami tempat bersemayamnya keyakinan yang sempurna, dan rumah-rumah kami tempat para ahlinya.
passages.en: Make our hearts the resting place of beneficial knowledge, and our homes the resting place of its masters; our hearts the resting place of knowledge of Allah, and our homes the resting place of its masters; our hearts the resting place of restraining scrupulousness, and our homes the resting place of its masters; our hearts the resting place of complete certainty, and our homes the resting place of its masters.

passages.ar: وثبتنا على الحق فيما نقولُ، وثبّتنا على الحقّ فيما نفعل، وثبّتنا على الحقّ فيما نعتقدُ، واعصمنا من الشّرك، واغفر لنا ما دون ذلك.
passages.tr: Wa tsabbitnâ `alal-haqqi fîmâ naqûl, wa tsabbitnâ `alal-haqqi fîmâ naf`al, wa tsabbitnâ `alal-haqqi fîmâ na`taqid, wa`shimnâ minasy-syirk, waghfir lanâ mâ dûna dzâlik.
passages.id_: Teguhkanlah kami di atas kebenaran dalam apa yang kami ucapkan, teguhkanlah kami di atas kebenaran dalam apa yang kami lakukan, dan teguhkanlah kami di atas kebenaran dalam apa yang kami yakini; peliharalah kami dari syirik, dan ampunilah kami atas dosa selain itu.
passages.en: Make us firm upon the truth in what we say, firm upon the truth in what we do, and firm upon the truth in what we believe; protect us from associating anything with You, and forgive us all that falls short of that.

passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ هُبَّ علينا نسمةً مِن نَسَمَاتِ القُربِ الأعلى، وتولّنا بما تولّيتَ به خيار المَلَا، واسكب علينا سحابة من سحائب الفضل العَظِيم، وتولّنا بما تولّيتَ به أهل الصّراط المُستقيم.
passages.tr: Allâhumma hubba `alaynâ nasmatan min nasamâtil-qurbil-a`lâ, wa tawallanâ bimâ tawallayta bihi khiyâral-malâ, waskub `alaynâ sahâbatan min sahâ'ibil-fadhlil-`azhîm, wa tawallanâ bimâ tawallayta bihi ahlash-shirâthil-mustaqîm.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, hembuskanlah kepada kami semilir angin dari hembusan kedekatan tertinggi; uruslah kami sebagaimana Engkau mengurus insan-insan pilihan; curahkanlah kepada kami awan dari awan-awan karunia yang agung; dan uruslah kami sebagaimana Engkau mengurus ahli jalan yang lurus.
passages.en: O Allah, let a breeze of the breezes of the highest nearness blow upon us; take charge of us as You took charge of the finest of the assembly; pour down upon us a cloud of the clouds of immense bounty; and take charge of us as You took charge of the people of the straight path.

passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ كن لنا بما أنت أهله حيثما كنّا، وأينما كنّا، وأحبابنا وإخواننا هؤلاء، ومَن والانا فيك، أمدّنا وإيّاهم مِن إمداد عنايتك، وتأييدك وتسديدك، وإلهامك الرُّشْدَ، وتَمَامَ السَّعْدِ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma kun lanâ bimâ anta ahluhu haytsumâ kunnâ, wa aynamâ kunnâ, wa ahbâbanâ wa ikhwânanâ hâ'ulâ', wa man wâlânâ fîka, amiddanâ wa iyyâhum min imdâdi `inâyatika, wa ta'yîdika wa tasdîdika, wa ilhâmikar-rusyda, wa tamâmas-sa`d.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, jadilah bagi kami sebagaimana yang layak bagi-Mu di mana pun kami berada — juga bagi para kekasih dan saudara-saudara kami ini, serta siapa saja yang setia kepada kami karena-Mu. Bekalilah kami dan mereka dari limpahan inayah-Mu, dukungan dan bimbingan-Mu, ilham kebenaran dari-Mu, dan kesempurnaan kebahagiaan.
passages.en: O Allah, be for us as befits You wherever we are — and for these our beloved ones and brothers, and whoever is loyal to us for Your sake. Supply us and them from the reinforcement of Your care, Your support and Your right guidance, Your inspiring of right conduct, and the completion of felicity.

passages.ar: والحفظَ مِن كل مُوجِبٍ لحسرة وندامة، في الدّنيا والبرزخ ويوم القيامة، واربُطنا بالمُظَلَّلِ بالغمامة ﷺ، ربطًا لا انحلال له أبدا.
passages.tr: Wal-hifzha min kulli mûjibin lihasratin wa nadâmah, fid-dunyâ wal-barzakhi wa yaumil-qiyâmah, warbuthnâ bil-muzhallali bil-ghamâmati shallallâhu `alayhi wa sallam, rabthan lâ inhilâla lahu abadâ.
passages.id_: Dan peliharalah kami dari segala penyebab penyesalan dan kerugian, di dunia, alam barzakh, dan hari kiamat; dan ikatlah kami dengan beliau yang dinaungi awan ﷺ, dengan ikatan yang tak pernah terurai selamanya.
passages.en: And grant protection from everything that leads to regret and remorse, in this world, in the intermediate realm, and on the Day of Resurrection; and bind us to the one shaded by the cloud ﷺ with a bond that never loosens.

passages.ar: وَثَبِّتنا في ديوانِ أهل القَبُولِ، وأَنِلْنَا غَايَاتِ السُّول، واختم لنا أجمعين بأكمل الحسنى وأنت راضٍ عنَّا في خير ولطف وعافية.
passages.tr: Wa tsabbitnâ fî dîwâni ahlil-qabûl, wa anilnâ ghâyâtis-sûl, wakhtim lanâ ajma`îna bi'akmalil-husnâ wa anta râdhin `annâ fî khayrin wa luthfin wa `âfiyah.
passages.id_: Teguhkanlah kami dalam daftar orang-orang yang diterima, sampaikanlah kami pada puncak segala permohonan, dan tutuplah hidup kami semua dengan husnul khatimah yang paling sempurna — dalam keadaan Engkau ridha kepada kami — dalam kebaikan, kelembutan, dan afiat.
passages.en: Establish us in the register of the people of acceptance, grant us the utmost of what is asked, and seal all our lives with the most complete good — while You are pleased with us — in goodness, gentleness, and wellbeing.

passages.ar: واربُطْنَا بحبيبِكَ محمد ﷺ ربطًا لا ينحلُّ، ولا ينفضّ أبَدَ الآبدين، واجعلنا مِن أسعد أُمَّتِه بِه ظاهرًا وباطنًا في الدُّنيا والبرزخ والآخرة، بِسِرِّ الفاتحة، وإلى حضرة النبي ﷺ.
passages.tr: Warbuthnâ bihabîbika Muhammadin shallallâhu `alayhi wa sallam rabthan lâ yanhallu, wa lâ yanfadhdhu abadal-âbidîn, waj`alnâ min as`adi ummatihi bihi zhâhiran wa bâthinan fid-dunyâ wal-barzakhi wal-âkhirah, bisirril-Fâtihah, wa ilâ hadhratin-nabiyyi shallallâhu `alayhi wa sallam.
passages.id_: Ikatlah kami dengan kekasih-Mu Muhammad ﷺ dengan ikatan yang tak pernah terurai dan tak pernah terputus selama-lamanya, dan jadikanlah kami termasuk umat beliau yang paling berbahagia dengannya, lahir dan batin, di dunia, alam barzakh, dan akhirat — dengan rahasia al-Fatihah, dan ke hadirat Nabi ﷺ.
passages.en: Bind us to Your beloved Muhammad ﷺ with a bond that never loosens nor breaks for all eternity, and make us among the happiest of his Ummah through him, outwardly and inwardly, in this world, the intermediate realm, and the Hereafter — by the secret of al-Fatihah, and to the presence of the Prophet ﷺ.

passages.sub: What is to be said when visiting the graves of the righteous
passages.ar: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ. السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ -دَارَ قَوْمٍ مُؤْمِنِينَ-، وَأَتَاكُمْ مَا تُوعَدُونَ، غَدًا مُؤَجَّلُونَ، وَإِنَّا -إِنْ شَاءَ اللهُ- بِكُمْ لَاحِقُونَ.
passages.tr: Bismillâhir-rahmânir-rahîm. As-salâmu `alaykum -dâra qaumin mu'minîn-, wa atâkum mâ tû`adûn, ghadan mu'ajjalûn, wa innâ -insyâ Allâhu- bikum lâhiqûn.
passages.id_: Dengan nama Allah Yang Maha Pengasih lagi Maha Penyayang. Salam sejahtera atas kalian, wahai penghuni negeri kaum beriman. Telah datang kepada kalian apa yang dijanjikan; esok hanyalah waktu yang ditangguhkan, dan kami — insya Allah — akan menyusul kalian.
passages.en: In the Name of Allah, Most Compassionate, Ever-Merciful. Peace be upon you, O abode of believing people. What you were promised has come to you; tomorrow is but deferred, and we — if Allah wills — shall join you.

passages.sub: What is to be said when visiting the graves of the righteous
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ.
passages.tr: Allâhummaghfir lahum warhamhum.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, ampunilah mereka dan kasihanilah mereka.
passages.en: O Allah, forgive them and have mercy on them.

passages.sub: What is to be said when visiting the graves of the righteous
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَى أَهْلِ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ المُؤْمِنِينَ وَالمُسْلِمِينَ، وَيَرْحَمُ اللهُ المُسْتَقْدِمِينَ وَالمُسْتَأْخِرِينَ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alâ ahlid-diyâri minal-mu'minîna wal-muslimîn, wa yarhamullâhul-mustaqdimîna wal-musta'khirîn.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas para penghuni negeri ini dari kalangan kaum mukminin dan muslimin; semoga Allah merahmati mereka yang mendahului dan yang datang kemudian.
passages.en: Peace be upon the dwellers of these abodes from among the believers and the Muslims; and may Allah have mercy on those who went ahead and those who follow after.

passages.sub: What is to be said when visiting the graves of the righteous
passages.ar: أَسْأَلُ اللهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ العَافِيَةَ؛ أَنْتُمْ لَنَا فَرَطٌ وَنَحْنُ لَكُمْ تَبَعٌ.
passages.tr: As'alullâha lanâ wa lakumul-`âfiyah; antum lanâ farathun wa nahnu lakum taba`.
passages.id_: Aku memohon kepada Allah keselamatan bagi kami dan bagi kalian; kalian telah mendahului kami, dan kami akan menyusul kalian.
passages.en: I ask Allah for wellbeing, for us and for you; you have gone ahead of us, and we shall follow you.

passages.sub: What is to be said when visiting the graves of the righteous
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَى أَهْلِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ، مِنْ أَهْلِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alâ ahli lâ ilâha illallâh, min ahli lâ ilâha illallâh.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas ahli la ilaha illallah, dari ahli la ilaha illallah.
passages.en: Peace be upon the people of la ilaha illallah, from people of la ilaha illallah.

passages.sub: What is to be said when visiting the graves of the righteous
passages.ar: -يَا أَهْلَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ-، كَيْفَ وَجَدْتُمْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ؟!
passages.tr: Yâ ahla lâ ilâha illallâh, kayfa wajadtum lâ ilâha illallâh?
passages.id_: Wahai ahli la ilaha illallah — bagaimana kalian mendapati la ilaha illallah?
passages.en: O people of la ilaha illallah — how have you found la ilaha illallah?

passages.sub: What is to be said when visiting the graves of the righteous
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بِحَقِّ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ، اغْفِرْ لِمَنْ قَالَ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma bihaqqi lâ ilâha illallâh, ighfir liman qâla: lâ ilâha illallâh.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, demi kebenaran la ilaha illallah, ampunilah siapa saja yang mengucapkan: la ilaha illallah.
passages.en: O Allah, by the right of la ilaha illallah, forgive everyone who has said: la ilaha illallah.

passages.sub: What is to be said when visiting the graves of the righteous
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum yâ (...).
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu, wahai (sebutkan nama yang diziarahi).
passages.en: Peace be upon you, O (here name the one being visited).

passages.sub: What is to be said when visiting the graves of the righteous
passages.id_: Kemudian membaca:
passages.en: Then recite:

passages.sub: What is to be said when visiting the graves of the righteous
passages.ar: الفَاتِحَةَ، وَآيَةَ الكُرْسِيِّ، وَسُورَةَ الإِخْلَاصِ (ثَلَاثًا)، وَالمُعَوِّذَتَيْنِ (مَرَّةً مَرَّةً).
passages.tr: Al-Fâtihah, wa âyatal-Kursî, wa sûratal-Ikhlâsh (tsalâtsâ), wal-Mu`awwidzatayn (marratan marratan).
passages.id_: Al-Fatihah; Ayat Kursi; Surah al-Ikhlas (3 kali); dan al-Mu'awwidzatain (masing-masing sekali).
passages.en: Al-Fatihah; Ayat al-Kursi; Surah al-Ikhlas (three times); and the two Surahs of refuge, al-Falaq and an-Nas (once each).

passages.sub: What is to be said when visiting the graves of the righteous
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَوْصِلْ ثَوَابَ مَا قَرَأْنَا إِلَى رُوحِ سَيِّدِنَا وَحَبِيبِنَا رَسُولِ اللهِ، وَأَرْوَاحِ إِخْوَانِهِ مِنَ الأَنْبِيَاءِ وَالمُرْسَلِينَ، وَآلِهِمْ وَصَحْبِهِمْ أَجْمَعِينَ، وَأَهْلِ هَذَا المَقَامِ (المَقْبَرَةِ). وَاغْفِرِ اللَّهُمَّ لَنَا وَلَهُمْ بِسِرِّ الفَاتِحَةِ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma aushil tsawâba mâ qara'nâ ilâ rûhi sayyidinâ wa habîbinâ rasûlillâh, wa arwâhi ikhwânihi minal-anbiyâ'i wal-mursalîn, wa âlihim wa shahbihim ajma`în, wa ahli hâdzal-maqâm (al-maqbarah). Waghfirillâhumma lanâ wa lahum bisirril-Fâtihah.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, sampaikanlah pahala apa yang telah kami baca kepada ruh junjungan dan kekasih kami, Rasulullah; kepada arwah saudara-saudara beliau dari kalangan para nabi dan rasul beserta segenap keluarga dan sahabat mereka; dan kepada para penghuni maqam (pemakaman) ini. Dan ampunilah kami dan mereka, ya Allah, dengan rahasia al-Fatihah.
passages.en: O Allah, convey the reward of what we have recited to the soul of our master and our beloved, the Messenger of Allah; to the souls of his brothers among the Prophets and Messengers, with all their Families and Companions; and to the people of this resting place (this cemetery). And forgive us and them, O Allah, by the secret of al-Fatihah.

passages.sub: What is to be said when visiting the graves of the righteous
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَوِّحْ أَرْوَاحَهُمْ، وَقَدِّسْ أَسْرَارَهُمْ، وَنَوِّرْ ضَرَائِحَهُمْ، وَطَيِّبْ مَرَاقِدَهُمْ، وَعَطِّرْ مَشَاعِرَهُمْ، وَأَعْلِ دَرَجَاتِهِمْ، وَكَثِّرْ مَثُوبَاتِهِمْ، وَضَاعِفْ حَسَنَاتِهِمْ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma rawwih arwâhahum, wa qaddis asrârahum, wa nawwir dharâ'ihahum, wa thayyib marâqidahum, wa `aththir masyâ`irahum, wa a`li darajâtihim, wa katstsir matsûbâtihim, wa dhâ`if hasanâtihim.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, lapangkanlah ruh-ruh mereka, sucikanlah rahasia-rahasia mereka, terangilah pusara-pusara mereka, harumkanlah tempat pembaringan mereka, wangikanlah tempat-tempat persemayaman mereka, tinggikanlah derajat mereka, perbanyaklah pahala mereka, dan lipatgandakanlah kebaikan-kebaikan mereka.
passages.en: O Allah, give ease to their souls, sanctify their secrets, illumine their tombs, make pleasant their resting places, perfume their sanctuaries, raise their degrees, multiply their rewards, and double their good deeds.

passages.sub: What is to be said when visiting the graves of the righteous
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَفِضْ عَلَيْهِمْ سَجْلًا مِنْ بِرِّكَ وَلُطْفِكَ وَجُودِكَ وَكَرَمِكَ وَإِنْعَامِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ وَإِحْسَانِكَ وَامْتِنَانِكَ، وَافْتَحْ لَهُمْ بَابَ جِنَانِكَ، وَأَنْزِلْهُمْ مِنْ سُرَادِقَاتِ عِزِّكَ، وَحَظَائِرِ قُدْسِكَ، وَزَوَايَا أُنْسِكَ، مَعَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالصِّدِّيقِينَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ وَالصَّالِحِينَ، وَزِدْهُمْ تَشْرِيفًا وَتَعْظِيمًا وَتَكْرِيمًا.
passages.tr: Allâhumma afidh `alayhim sajlan min birrika wa luthfika wa jûdika wa karamika wa in`âmika wa rahmatika wa ihsânika wamtinânika, waftah lahum bâba jinânika, wa anzilhum min surâdiqâti `izzika, wa hazhâ'iri qudsika, wa zawâyâ unsika, ma`al-ladzîna an`amta `alayhim minan-nabiyyîna wash-shiddîqîna wasy-syuhadâ'i wash-shâlihîn, wa zidhum tasyrîfan wa ta`zhîman wa takrîmâ.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, limpahkanlah kepada mereka curahan kebaikan-Mu, kelembutan-Mu, kedermawanan-Mu, kemurahan-Mu, anugerah-Mu, rahmat-Mu, kebaikan-Mu, dan karunia-Mu; bukakanlah bagi mereka pintu surga-Mu; dan tempatkanlah mereka di naungan kemuliaan-Mu, di taman kesucian-Mu, dan di sudut-sudut keakraban dengan-Mu — bersama mereka yang telah Engkau beri nikmat dari kalangan para nabi, para shiddiqin, para syuhada, dan orang-orang saleh; serta tambahkanlah bagi mereka kemuliaan, keagungan, dan penghormatan.
passages.en: O Allah, pour out upon them a flood of Your goodness, Your kindness, Your generosity, Your nobility, Your favours, Your mercy, Your beneficence, and Your grace; open for them the gate of Your Gardens; and lodge them within the pavilions of Your might, the enclosures of Your holiness, and the corners of Your intimacy — together with those You have favoured of the Prophets, the most truthful, the martyrs, and the righteous; and increase them in honour, esteem, and dignity.

passages.sub: What is to be said when visiting the graves of the righteous
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَإِنَّا قَدْ وَقَفْنَا عَلَى عَتَبَاتِ أَوْلِيَائِكَ، وَالصَّالِحِينَ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ عَنْ خُشُوعٍ وَخُضُوعٍ وَاسْتِكَانَةٍ، مُتَوَسِّلِينَ بِهِمْ فِي قَضَاءِ حَاجَاتِنَا وَمُهِمَّاتِنَا وَإِنْجَاحِ طَلِبَاتِنَا وَكِفَايَةِ الشُّرُورِ مِنَ الجِنِّ وَالإِنْسِ وَالشَّيَاطِينِ، وَالشَّدَائِدِ وَإِزَالَةِ المِحَنِ عَنَّا، وَحُصُولِ المِنَنِ وَكِفَايَةِ أَذِيَّاتِ الظَّالِمِينَ وَالمُعَانِدِينَ، فَلَا تُخَيِّبْنَا مِنْ نَيْلِ مَا نَرْجُوهُ وَنُؤَمِّلُهُ، وَلَا تَرُدَّنَا صِفْرَ الأَيَادِي.
passages.tr: Allâhumma wa innâ qad waqafnâ `alâ `atabâti auliyâ'ika, wash-shâlihîna min `ibâdika `an khusyû`in wa khudhû`in wastikânah, mutawassilîna bihim fî qadhâ'i hâjâtinâ wa muhimmâtinâ wa injâhi thalibâtinâ wa kifâyatisy-syurûri minal-jinni wal-insi wasy-syayâthîn, wasy-syadâ'idi wa izâlatil-mihani `annâ, wa hushûlil-minani wa kifâyati adziyyâtizh-zhâlimîna wal-mu`ânidîn, falâ tukhayyibnâ min nayli mâ narjûhu wa nu'ammiluh, wa lâ taruddanâ shifral-ayâdî.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami telah berdiri di ambang pintu para wali-Mu dan hamba-hamba-Mu yang saleh dengan khusyuk, tunduk, dan merendahkan diri, bertawasul dengan mereka demi terkabulnya hajat dan kepentingan kami, berhasilnya permohonan kami, terlindunginya kami dari kejahatan jin, manusia, dan setan serta dari kesulitan-kesulitan, tersingkirnya cobaan dari kami, diperolehnya karunia, dan terlindunginya kami dari gangguan orang-orang zalim dan para pembangkang. Maka janganlah Engkau kecewakan kami dari meraih apa yang kami harapkan dan cita-citakan, dan janganlah Engkau kembalikan kami dengan tangan hampa.
passages.en: O Allah, we have stood at the thresholds of Your friends and the righteous among Your servants in humility, submission, and lowliness, seeking through them the fulfilment of our needs and our concerns, the success of our requests, protection from the evils of jinn, men, and devils and from hardships, the removal of trials from us, the attainment of favours, and protection from the harm of oppressors and the obstinate. So do not deny us the attainment of what we hope for and aspire to, and do not turn us away empty-handed.

passages.sub: What is to be said when visiting the graves of the righteous
passages.ar: وَأَنْجِزْ آمَالَنَا، وَاقْبَلْ وَسِيلَتَنَا، وَاجْعَلْنَا مَحْظُوظِينَ مِنْ بَرَكَاتِهِمْ، مَلْحُوظِينَ بِأَعْيُنِ عِنَايَاتِهِمْ، وَاكْتُبْنَا فِي دِيوَانِ عِبَادِكَ الَّذِينَ ﴿لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ﴾.
passages.tr: Wa anjiz âmâlanâ, waqbal wasîlatanâ, waj`alnâ mahzhûzhîna min barakâtihim, malhûzhîna bi'a`yuni `inâyâtihim, waktubnâ fî dîwâni `ibâdikal-ladzîna lâ khaufun `alayhim wa lâ hum yahzanûn.
passages.id_: Tunaikanlah harapan-harapan kami, terimalah wasilah kami, jadikanlah kami beruntung dengan keberkahan mereka dan terpelihara dalam pandangan inayah mereka, dan catatlah kami dalam daftar hamba-hamba-Mu yang "tiada rasa takut atas mereka dan tiada pula mereka bersedih hati".
passages.en: Bring our hopes to fulfilment, accept our means of approach, make us fortunate through their blessings and watched over by the eyes of their care, and inscribe us in the register of Your servants "upon whom there is no fear, nor shall they grieve".

passages.sub: What is to be said when visiting the graves of the righteous
passages.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِوَالِدِينَا وَالمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالمُؤْمِنَاتِ إِنَّكَ مُجِيبُ الدَّعَوَاتِ، وَقَابِلُ التَّوْبَاتِ، وَسَامِعُ الأَصْوَاتِ.
passages.tr: Waghfir lanâ wa liwâlidînâ wal-mu'minîna wal-mu'minât, innaka mujîbud-da`awâti, wa qâbilut-taubâti, wa sâmi`ul-ashwât.
passages.id_: Dan ampunilah kami, kedua orang tua kami, serta kaum mukminin dan mukminat; sesungguhnya Engkau Maha Mengabulkan doa, Maha Menerima tobat, dan Maha Mendengar segala suara.
passages.en: And forgive us, our parents, and the believing men and women; truly You are the Answerer of supplications, the Accepter of repentance, and the Hearer of all voices.

passages.sub: What is to be said when visiting the graves of the righteous
passages.ar: ﴿سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ ۝ وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَى ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ ۝ وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ﴾ وَصَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ أَجْمَعِينَ.
passages.tr: Subhâna rabbika rabbil-`izzati `ammâ yashifûn, wa salâmun `alal-mursalîn, wal-hamdu lillâhi rabbil-`âlamîn. Wa shallallâhu `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin wa âlihi wa shahbihi ajma`în.
passages.id_: "Maha Suci Tuhanmu, Tuhan pemilik kemuliaan, dari apa yang mereka sifatkan. Dan selamat sejahtera bagi para rasul. Dan segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan seru sekalian alam." [Surah ash-Shaffat 37:180–182] Dan semoga Allah melimpahkan shalawat atas junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad beserta segenap keluarga dan sahabat beliau.
passages.en: "Glorified is your Lord, the Lord of Honour, above what they describe; and peace be upon the Messengers; and all praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds" [Surah as-Saffat 37:180–182]. And may Allah bestow prayers upon our master Muhammad and all his Family and Companions.

passages.sub: What is to be said when visiting the graves of the righteous
passages.id_: Qasidah: Salamullah ya sadah
passages.en: The qasidah: Salamullah ya sadah

passages.sub: What is to be said when visiting the graves of the righteous
passages.ar: سَلَامُ اللهِ -يَا سَادَه- * مِنَ الرَّحْمَنِ يَغْشَاكُم. -عِبَادَ اللهِ- جِئْنَاكُم * قَصَدْنَاكُم، طَلَبْنَاكُم. تُعِينُونَا، تُغِيثُونَا * بِهِمَّتِكُم، وَجَدْوَاكُم. فَأَحْبُونَا، وَأَعْطُونَا * عَطَايَاكُم، هَدَايَاكُم.
passages.tr: Salâmullâhi -yâ sâdah- * minar-Rahmâni yaghsyâkum. `Ibâdallâhi ji'nâkum * qashadnâkum, thalabnâkum. Tu`înûnâ, tughîtsûnâ * bihimmatikum, wa jadwâkum. Fa ahbûnâ, wa a`thûnâ * `athâyâkum, hadâyâkum.
passages.id_: Salam Allah — wahai para sayyid — dari Yang Maha Pengasih meliputi kalian. Wahai hamba-hamba Allah, kami datang kepada kalian; kami menuju dan mengharapkan kalian. Tolonglah kami, bantulah kami, dengan himmah dan kemurahan kalian. Maka sambutlah kami dan berilah kami pemberian dan hadiah kalian.
passages.en: The peace of Allah, O masters, from the All-Merciful envelop you. O servants of Allah, we have come to you; we have sought you out and called upon you. Aid us and come to our rescue, by your lofty resolve and your bounty. So receive us kindly, and grant us your gifts and your presents.

passages.sub: What is to be said when visiting the graves of the righteous
passages.ar: فَلَا خَيَّبْتُمُ ظَنِّي * فَحَاشَاكُم، وَحَاشَاكُم. سَعِدْنَا إِذْ أَتَيْنَاكُم * وَفُزْنَا حِينَ زُرْنَاكُم. فَقُومُوا، وَاشْفَعُوا فِينَا * إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ مَوْلَاكُم. عَسَى نَحْظَى، عَسَى نُعْطَى * مَزَايَا مِنْ مَزَايَاكُم.
passages.tr: Falâ khayyabtumu zhannî * fahâsyâkum, wa hâsyâkum. Sa`idnâ idz ataynâkum * wa fuznâ hîna zurnâkum. Faqûmû, wasyfa`û fînâ * ilar-Rahmâni maulâkum. `Asâ nahzhâ, `asâ nu`thâ * mazâyâ min mazâyâkum.
passages.id_: Kalian tak akan mengecewakan harapanku — mustahil itu bagi kalian, sungguh mustahil! Kami berbahagia saat mendatangi kalian, dan beruntung saat menziarahi kalian. Maka bangkitlah dan berilah kami syafaat di hadapan Yang Maha Pengasih, Pelindung kalian. Semoga kami beroleh anugerah, semoga kami diberi keistimewaan dari keistimewaan kalian.
passages.en: Never would you disappoint my hope — far be it from you, far be it from you! We were gladdened when we came to you, and we prospered when we visited you. So rise and intercede for us with the All-Merciful, your Protector. That we may be favoured, that we may be granted merits from among your merits.

passages.sub: What is to be said when visiting the graves of the righteous
passages.ar: عَسَى نَظْرَهْ، عَسَى رَحْمَهْ * تَغَشَّانَا، وَتَغْشَاكُم. سَلَامُ اللهِ حَيَّاكُم * وَعَيْنُ اللهِ تَرْعَاكُم. وَصَلَّى اللهُ مَوْلَانَا * وَسَلَّمَ مَا أَتَيْنَاكُم. عَلَى المُخْتَارِ شَافِعِنَا * وَمُنْقِذِنَا، وَإِيَّاكُم.
passages.tr: `Asâ nazhrah, `asâ rahmah * taghasysyânâ, wa taghsyâkum. Salâmullâhi hayyâkum * wa `aynullâhi tar`âkum. Wa shallallâhu maulânâ * wa sallama mâ ataynâkum. `Alal-Mukhtâri syâfi`inâ * wa munqidzinâ, wa iyyâkum.
passages.id_: Semoga pandangan kasih, semoga rahmat, meliputi kami dan meliputi kalian. Salam Allah menyambut kalian, dan penjagaan Allah memelihara kalian. Dan semoga Allah, Pelindung kami, melimpahkan shalawat dan salam — selama kami terus mendatangi kalian — atas Nabi pilihan, pemberi syafaat dan penyelamat kami, dan juga atas kalian.
passages.en: Perhaps a glance of grace, perhaps a mercy, will envelop us and envelop you. May Allah's peace greet you, and Allah's watchful eye guard you. And may Allah, our Protector, bestow prayers and peace — for as long as we keep coming to you — upon the Chosen One, our intercessor and our deliverer, and upon you.

passages.sub: What is to be said when visiting the graves of the righteous
passages.ar: أَلَا -يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ- غَارَةَ مُنْجِدٍ * وَنَجْدَةَ ذِي جَاهٍ، بِهَا لَا تُؤَجِّلِ. وَ-يَا آلَ طَهَ- غَارَةً عَلَوِيَّةً * بِهَا تَنْقَضِي الحَاجَاتُ، وَالهَمُّ يَنْجَلِي. سَرِيعًا، سَرِيعًا هَيَّ هَيَّ بِكُمْ، فَمَا * عَلَى غَيْرِكُم عِنْدَ الخُطُوبِ مُعَوَّلِي.
passages.tr: Alâ -yâ rasûlallâhi- ghârata munjidin * wa najdata dzî jâhin, bihâ lâ tu'ajjil. Wa -yâ âla Thâhâ- ghâratan `alawiyyatan * bihâ tanqadhil-hâjâtu, wal-hammu yanjalî. Sarî`an, sarî`an hayya hayya bikum, famâ * `alâ ghayrikum `indal-khuthûbi mu`awwalî.
passages.id_: Duhai Rasulullah — pertolongan seorang penyelamat dan bantuan pemilik kedudukan tinggi: janganlah engkau tunda! Dan wahai keluarga Thaha — pertolongan alawiyah yang dengannya segala hajat terpenuhi dan kegundahan tersingkap. Cepat, cepatlah — bersegeralah demi kalian! Sebab kepada selain kalian aku tidak bersandar ketika bencana menimpa.
passages.en: O Messenger of Allah — the swift aid of a rescuer, the succour of one of high standing: do not delay it! And O Family of Taha — an Alawi rescue by which needs are fulfilled and worry is dispelled. Quickly, quickly — hasten, hasten, by you! For upon none but you do I rely when calamities strike.
